title: Laying Plans
sourceOrigin: Project Gutenberg eBook #17405, The Art of War by Sunzi, Lionel Giles translation, 1910, public domain

approvedQuoteLedger.text: The art of war is of vital importance to the State.
All warfare is based on deception.
Thus do many calculations lead to victory, and few calculations to defeat.

structureSummary.part1: paragraphs 1-2: frame war as state-survival problem
structureSummary.part2: paragraphs 3-11: the five constant factors (Moral Law, Heaven, Earth, Commander, Method and discipline)
structureSummary.part3: paragraphs 12-15: seven comparative questions for forecasting victory
structureSummary.part4: paragraphs 16-17: adapting plans to favorable circumstances
structureSummary.part5: paragraphs 18-25: deception as the operational method
structureSummary.part6: paragraph 26: temple calculations as the pre-battle decision system
